content:
tara (Design): quick pass on the model details side-rail — keyboard users lose context when the rail opens. focus lands on the close icon and when you close it focus doesn't return to the originating list item. recording: https://img.redwood/rail/focus.mp4 ben (Frontend): that's because we mount the rail as a portal and call .focus() on the close button by default. we forgot to stash the opener element. olga (A11y): we should implement focus restoration: save document.activeElement when opening, and on close `.focus()` back to it. Also ensure the opener has a clear `aria-expanded` toggle and reflects state. tara (Design): agree. small visual note: the close icon's hit target is 20x20 — too small for keyboard and touch. per touch guidelines we should make it at least 36x36. ben (Frontend): will increase padding to meet 44px touch target visually, keep icon centered. CSS change only. mike (QA): test matrix: focus restore works in Safari+VoiceOver, Chrome+NVDA, and Edge+JAWS. Also verify that if the opener was removed from DOM while rail open (rare), focus moves to a safe fallback like the top toolbar. olga (A11y): another thing: while the rail is open we must set `aria-hidden=true` on the main content region so screen readers don't double-navigate. But be careful: if the rail includes interactive controls that operate on the main content, don't hide semantically linked content. ben (Frontend): current pattern: `
...
` and rail portal appended to body. We'll toggle `document.getElementById('main').setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true')` on open and remove on close. Also set `aria-modal=\"true\"` on the rail container to indicate a modal-like interaction. olga (A11y): `aria-modal` is good for dialog semantics, but ensure role=\"dialog\" is present and the rail has `aria-labelledby` pointing to the title. For persistent side panels that are not modal we should avoid `aria-modal`. This rail is modal (blocks actions behind it) so dialog semantics are fine. tara (Design): color nit: action icons in the rail (save, revert) are grey on pale bg — contrast for the icon glyph is ~2.9:1. Need >=3:1 for focus ring and 4.5:1 for primary actions. ben (Frontend): i'll bump icon color to `#0f1720` on light theme and `#ffffff` on dark for primary actions; secondary actions can be `#9aa0a6` if it hits 3:1. olga (A11y): ensure keyboard focus styles are visible — 3px outline, and not just a drop shadow. Use `outline-offset: 2px`. Also for screen reader announcement, when the rail opens announce "Model details: . Press Escape to close." using a polite live region or dialog label. ben (Frontend): snippet I'll add: `

Model details — {{name}}

...
` and JS: `const opener = document.activeElement; openRail(); // on close: if(document.contains(opener)) opener.focus(); else document.querySelector('#top-toolbar').focus();` mike (QA): add tests: opener focus restored when opener still in DOM; fallback focus to toolbar; Escape closes and restores; `aria-hidden` toggling doesn't break skip-links. oli (A11y): small extra: for keyboard-only users who open multiple rails quickly, debounce focus restore so it doesn't steal focus while user intended to open the next one. And ensure Escape closes only the topmost rail when nested. ci-bot: accessibility-lint: rail-focus-restore (warn), rail-icon-contrast (medium). https://ci.redwood/a11y/2364507890 tara (Design): timeline: can we push in the next patch? looks small but critical for screen reader flow. ben (Frontend): estimate: 3 dev hrs (focus stash/restore, aria-hidden toggle, aria-modal semantics, icon color updates) + 1 QA. I'll open PR and tag olga/mike. olga (A11y): i'll review the PR and run VoiceOver/NVDA checks. Please include unit tests for aria-hidden toggling. ben (Frontend): PR -> https://git.redwood/pr/8560 (WIP). deploy preview -> https://deploy-preview.redwood/8560 tara (Design): thanks — appreciate closing the loop.
